cards.card_text: Joab's troops build a siege ramp against the city's outer rampart.
cards.verse_text: And Joab’s troops came and besieged Sheba in Abel-beth-maacah and built a siege ramp against the outer rampart of the city.
cards.snippet: …besieged Sheba in Abel-beth-maacah and built a siege ramp against the outer rampart of the city.

cards.card_text: Then the song gives an order: "March around Zion, encircle her, count her towers," then consider her ramparts and tour her citadels.
cards.verse_text: March around Zion, encircle her, count her towers, consider her ramparts, tour her citadels, that you may tell the next generation.
cards.snippet: March around Zion, encircle her, count her towers, consider her ramparts, tour her citadels, that you may tell the next generation.

cards.card_text: In the song sung in the land of Judah, salvation is what makes up the strong city's walls and ramparts.
cards.verse_text: In that day this song will be sung in the land of Judah: We have a strong city; salvation is established as its walls and ramparts.
cards.snippet: …We have a strong city; salvation is established as its walls and ramparts.

cards.card_text: The LORD determined to destroy the wall of the Daughter of Zion and stretched out a measuring line, and He made even the ramparts and walls lament.
cards.verse_text: He made the ramparts and walls lament; together they waste away.
cards.snippet: He made the ramparts and walls lament; together they waste away.

cards.card_text: At his guard post on the ramparts In the temple courts in Jerusalem In a cave on Mount Horeb
cards.verse_text: I will stand at my guard post and station myself on the ramparts.
cards.snippet: I will stand at my guard post and station myself on the ramparts.
